targets.note: A call answered from the caller's number: the caller's conversation is open with the call bar in its header (face, name, clock, mute, hold, keypad, transfer, record, end) and the Call tab of the side pane (Notes for this call, Last interactions, Open tasks, Open record). The prototype side is its callaway state, which opens the conversation with the live call.
After the call: the header holds the ended card with where the call was saved and Log a task, over the conversation.
The same call while another screen is open (the Unmatched list): the floating dock is the only call surface.
